keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Perr Schuurs (NEC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, NEC. Willum Willumsson replaces Perr Schuurs because of an injury.
Goal! NEC 0, Omonia Nicosia 1. Loïs Diony (Omonia Nicosia) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Panagiotis Andreou.
Clement Bischoff (NEC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, NEC 0, Omonia Nicosia 1.
